judged_text: The call passes `credentialId` — an identifier no other call site uses (all seven sibling sites pass `credential.userId`, matching the helper's `userId` parameter) and which is not defined in the visible scope — so tsc fails with "Cannot find name 'credentialId'". packages/app-store fails to compile and the PR cannot build as-is; if a like-named binding exists outside the hunk, the sync endpoint receives the credential row id instead of the cal.com user id and resolves the wrong user's credentials.
